question: v2
asks: How much in purchase obligations and supply commitments will NVIDIA disclose in its FY2027 Form 10-K, as reported in the purchase obligations and contractual commitments disclosures and related notes?
settles_on: The amount of purchase obligations/supply commitments NVIDIA reports in its contractual obligations and purchase commitment disclosures in the Form 10-K, versus the prior year, given the analyst report that NVIDIA is taking on larger supply commitments.

possible_answers.label: Neutral
possible_answers.holds_when: from 100,000,000,000 USD to below 150,000,000,000 USD (no reference figure when the question opened)
